areas.name: Route and Save Setup
areas.location_cue: The Meta Quest library, headset settings, cloud-backup page, and home journal.
areas.note: Chosen-route exception: the catalog prefers PC/PCVR, but Winter Warrior was released only for Meta Quest 2, Quest Pro, and Quest 3. No native Windows build or emulation route is documented.

items.label: Use the sourced Meta Quest release

levels.1: Confirm the headset edition before creating the completion profile.
levels.2: Install Sniper Elite VR: Winter Warrior from the Meta Quest store on supported Quest hardware.
levels.3: Install the native Quest release, update it before starting, and verify that the title screen says Winter Warrior. Do not substitute the earlier Sniper Elite VR PC build: it is a different game, and current official support lists Winter Warrior only on Quest 2, Quest Pro, and Quest 3.

levels.1: Protect the single local profile before long mastery sessions.
levels.2: Close the game, leave the headset powered and online, then check Meta's cloud-backup page for a recent Winter Warrior entry.
levels.3: Quit the app cleanly, connect the headset to power and Wi-Fi, and inspect Meta's cloud-backup page. Continue only if Winter Warrior shows a recent timestamp; if it has no entry, do not uninstall the game, factory-reset the headset, or assume the profile can be restored.

levels.1: Use the opening range to calibrate hands, height, and weapon handling.
levels.2: Finish every guided tutorial prompt until the home journal and mode pages become available.
levels.3: Set dominant hand, standing or seated height, turning, movement, comfort vignette, and rifle alignment first. Complete the guided shooting and interaction sequence, then return home and verify Campaign is available; Sniper Hunt and Last Stand unlock after the first operation is cleared.

items.label: Use every permanent mode in the current release

levels.1: The home journal separates campaign cleanup from two repeatable modes.
levels.2: Complete Campaign, Sniper Hunt, Last Stand, the permanent weapon rack, mission stars, collectibles, and combat records.
levels.3: After updating the Quest build, inspect every page following Loadout. The finite checklist is the campaign journal, all stars and collectibles, every standard and gold rack slot, the Sniper Hunt records, the Last Stand records, and the global combat conditions. Current sources expose no downloaded campaign, online branch, New Game Plus, or rotating event requirement.

levels.2: Complete every required objective in the coastal gun site and reach its result page.
levels.3: Complete the required objectives, wait for the operation-complete result to register, and return home only after the journal star appears. Mission Select can reopen the page for cleanup.

levels.1: The middle star rewards one deliberate combat or stealth pattern.

areas.name: Home and Loadout
areas.location_cue: The home journal, weapon rack, loadout page, and mode tabs.
areas.note: Reusable hub; no point of no return.

levels.1: Use the permanent rack to build one reliable cleanup kit.
levels.2: Equip one owned rifle, secondary weapon, sidearm, and available equipment on the Loadout page.
levels.3: At home, open Loadout, place an acquired weapon into every weapon slot, choose equipment, and confirm the selection. Leave and reopen the page once to verify that the setup persisted.

items.label: Use the journal for operation cleanup

levels.1: A cleared page remains available for unfinished stars and collectibles.
levels.2: Select any cleared operation from the campaign journal and replay it on the setting needed for cleanup.
levels.3: At home, reopen the campaign journal, select an operation with a hollow star or collectible count, and start it again. Verify the corrected icon after reaching a checkpoint or result page; do not assume a pickup or challenge saved if the app was closed immediately.

levels.1: The extra modes appear after the opening campaign training is established.
levels.2: Finish the tutorial and first operation, then turn past Loadout to reveal Last Stand and Sniper Hunt.
levels.3: Complete the tutorial and the first available campaign operation, return home, and turn the journal pages beyond Loadout. Confirm that both Last Stand and Sniper Hunt can be selected before beginning their record cleanup.

areas.name: Sniper Hunt
areas.location_cue: The repeatable mode page after Loadout and Last Stand, leading to open hunting grounds with patrols and distant marksmen.
areas.note: Unlocks after the tutorial and first operation. No permanent point of no return; each run ends at its result screen.

levels.1: Use patrols to draw out the harder targets, then change position.
levels.2: Defeat patrol groups to reveal enemy snipers and continue until the mode posts a final result.
levels.3: Enter Sniper Hunt from its home page, clear a patrol to lure an enemy sniper, eliminate that sniper, then relocate when the next hunting area opens. Continue through the run and remain for the final score card.

items.label: Spend thirty minutes in Sniper Hunt

levels.1: A careful long run can satisfy the duration naturally.
levels.2: Remain active in Sniper Hunt for at least thirty minutes before leaving the run.
levels.3: Start a fresh run, play normally, and do not exit to the home journal until thirty continuous minutes have elapsed in the mode. Paused or loading time may not count, so leave a buffer and finish the active encounter before checking the record.

items.label: Use exactly one round per enemy sniper

levels.1: Tag and steady before firing; a wound ruins the clean sequence.
levels.2: In one Sniper Hunt run, eliminate every revealed enemy sniper with a single bullet each.
levels.3: Use patrol eliminations to expose each sniper, tag the position, settle the scope, and fire one lethal rifle round. Restart the run after any miss or nonlethal hit against a sniper; patrol ammunition does not affect this condition.

levels.1: Preserve the multiplier with precise, distant shots.
levels.2: Complete a Sniper Hunt run with a final score higher than 9,000.
levels.3: Favor long-range head and organ hits, avoid wasted rounds, and clear every revealed sniper while the multiplier remains healthy. Continue until the result screen shows more than 9,000; an exact 9,000 does not satisfy an above-threshold instruction.

areas.name: Last Stand
areas.location_cue: The repeatable survival-mode page after Loadout, leading to a defensible arena with ammunition, weapons, and trap positions.
areas.note: Unlocks after the tutorial and first operation. No permanent point of no return; prepare between waves before triggering the next attack.

items.label: Complete a Last Stand result cycle

levels.1: Learn the supply points and establish a fallback position before later waves.
levels.2: Enter Last Stand, gather equipment, set traps, and survive until the run posts its result.
levels.3: Use the preparation window to collect weapons and ammunition, place traps along narrow approaches, and choose a defensible firing position. Survive successive waves until the run ends and remain for the recorded result card.

items.label: Eliminate two enemies with one bullet

levels.1: Wait for two advancing enemies to overlap from your firing angle.
levels.2: During Last Stand, line up two enemies and finish both with the same rifle round.
levels.3: Use a narrow approach, let two enemies overlap chest-to-head from the scope's perspective, and fire a penetrating rifle round through both. The one bullet must supply both final hits; an explosive follow-up or wounded survivor does not count.

items.label: Record fifty primary-weapon eliminations in Last Stand

levels.1: Use early waves to build the rifle counter safely.
levels.2: Accumulate fifty Last Stand eliminations with rifles in the primary slot.
levels.3: Keep a rifle in the primary slot and make it deliver fifty final hits across Last Stand runs. Check the persistent record between runs; damage followed by a sidearm finish credits the finishing weapon instead.

items.label: Record fifty secondary-weapon eliminations in Last Stand

levels.1: Short approaches make automatic weapons easier to control.
levels.2: Accumulate fifty Last Stand eliminations with weapons in the secondary slot.
levels.3: Equip a secondary weapon, funnel enemies into a close or medium lane, and make that weapon provide fifty final hits across runs. Conserve its ammunition during preparation phases and verify the persistent counter afterward.

items.label: Record fifty sidearm eliminations in Last Stand

levels.1: Weakened enemies are efficient sidearm finishes when ammunition is scarce.
levels.2: Accumulate fifty Last Stand eliminations with pistols in the sidearm slot.
levels.3: Use early waves or deliberately weakened enemies, switch to the sidearm before the finishing shot, and reach fifty credited kills across runs. A rifle or trap final hit will not advance this weapon-family counter.

levels.1: Accurate streaks and efficient trap placement keep the total climbing.
levels.2: End a Last Stand run with a final score higher than 15,000.
levels.3: Prepare every safe lane, use traps for dense groups, and favor accurate head or organ hits while avoiding wasted ammunition. Continue surviving until the score is safely beyond 15,000, then confirm the value on the result card.

areas.name: Campaign Records and Final Audit
areas.location_cue: Campaign replays, result cards, mode records, and the home journal's persistent completion pages.
areas.note: All listed conditions are replayable. Identity-sensitive source wording is replaced by mechanical primary-target and decoy language.

items.label: Destroy the heavy vehicle with three launchers

levels.1: Preserve each heavy launcher until the vehicle is exposed.
levels.2: At the tank minefield, hit the heavy vehicle with all three available Panzerfaust launchers.
levels.3: Search the route for all three Panzerfausts before committing to the vehicle encounter, carry each to a safe firing angle, and land all three rockets on the vehicle. Do not waste a round on infantry or scenery; a missed launcher can require an operation restart.

items.label: Destroy the approaching aircraft before it lands

levels.1: Prepare the firing position before the aircraft reaches the runway.
levels.2: At the frozen airfield, destroy the incoming prototype aircraft while it is still airborne.
levels.3: Reach the airfield firing sequence with ammunition ready, acquire the approaching aircraft as soon as it enters the open lane, and keep firing at its vulnerable sections until it breaks apart before touching down. Restart the operation if it lands first.

items.label: Identify the correct primary target three times consecutively

levels.1: Observe distinguishing details before choosing among matching officers.
levels.2: At the alpine estate, select the genuine primary target correctly in three consecutive attempts.
levels.3: Replay the estate identification sequence three times, study the operation's current physical tell, and eliminate only the genuine primary target on each run. A wrong decoy resets the consecutive sequence; because the exact randomized tell is not reliably transcribed, verify it in the current journal briefing.

items.label: Defeat an enemy sniper with an eye hit

levels.1: Wait for a distant marksman to expose the face fully.
levels.2: At the bunker-trap site, place the finishing rifle round through an enemy sniper's eye.
levels.3: Tag an enemy sniper, settle the scope while the face is unobstructed, and place a lethal round through the eye rather than the broader head region. Wait for the detailed hit confirmation before continuing.

items.label: Disable the coastal gun without being seen

levels.1: Use sound cover and break sightlines after every shot.
levels.2: Complete the coastal gun objective without any enemy fully identifying you.
levels.3: Use crouched cover, mark patrols, fire only under environmental sound or from a position you can abandon, and prevent the detection indicator from completing. Disable the gun and reach the result trigger in that same unseen run; restart after full detection.

items.label: Reach the bunker without being seen

levels.1: The blizzard shortens sightlines, but close patrols still matter.
levels.2: On the blizzard-bunker route, reach the required bunker before any enemy fully identifies you.
levels.3: Stay low, use the storm and solid cover to cross open ground, wait for patrol backs to turn, and avoid shots that expose your route. The condition ends when the required bunker is reached; restart the operation if the detection indicator completes first.

items.label: Clear the primary target and every matching decoy

levels.1: Do not leave the estate after the correct identification; inspect every matching officer position.
levels.2: During one alpine-estate visit, eliminate the genuine primary target and all matching decoys before finishing.
levels.3: Identify and eliminate the genuine primary target, then search every remaining marked officer position and eliminate each decoy during the same operation. Confirm no matching marker remains before triggering the result.

items.label: Land a testicle hit on the primary target

levels.1: A stable side or frontal angle makes the organ region easier to isolate.
levels.2: At the alpine estate, make the lethal or credited rifle hit register on the primary target's testicle region.
levels.3: Identify the genuine primary target first, wait for an unobstructed lower-torso angle, and place the rifle round through the testicle region. Continue only after the detailed hit display identifies the required organ; an ordinary pelvis hit does not count.

items.label: Clear every campaign operation on Sniper Elite difficulty

levels.1: Save the hardest pass until the rack holds a familiar quiet rifle and sidearm.
levels.2: Replay each campaign operation with Sniper Elite selected and verify every page's difficulty clear.
levels.3: Select Sniper Elite before each uncleared operation and keep that setting active through its result page. Use checkpoints, sound masking, healing, and conservative cover as needed; stars and collectibles can be cleaned separately on an easier setting.

levels.1: Each journal page tracks a clear, a special condition, and a score target.
levels.2: Audit every operation page until all three star positions are filled.
levels.3: For each campaign page, confirm the ordinary clear star, middle condition star, and score star. Replay only the missing condition, reach the result page, and reopen the journal to ensure the icon persisted before moving to another operation.

levels.2: Make every nonzero scarf, letter, last-letter, and stone-eagle counter complete across the campaign journal.
levels.3: NEEDS_VERIFICATION

levels.2: Verify that every rifle, secondary weapon, and sidearm has its gold mastery form.
levels.3: At the home rack, inspect the gold slot paired with every permanent weapon model. The internal record specifically tracks the M1 Garand, Walther PPK, MP44, and M1911, but full in-game completion also requires filling all remaining gold slots; any unsupported recipe remains marked for gameplay verification rather than guessed.

levels.2: Confirm all operation stars and collectible counters, every weapon slot, both repeatable-mode records, the hardest difficulty clear, and every combat record.
levels.3: At home, page through the full campaign journal, inspect every collectible counter and star, scan the entire weapon rack for ordinary and gold gaps, review Sniper Hunt and Last Stand results, and confirm all situational records. No online, seasonal, downloaded, or New Game Plus branch is currently part of this release.
